content.short: Snapchain enables scaling on-chain games and DeFi apps with ZK Rollups.
content.description: Snapchain is a ZK-Rollup-as-a-Service platform that enables internet-scale dApps. It provides a private, secure environment to host and scale your own private decentralized network without compromise, giving developers a dedicated space to run intensive workloads and complex logic at scale. From fully on-chain games to transaction-intensive DeFi apps, Snapchain operates through a Rollup-as-a-Service platform, combining zk-rollup technology with private, scalable infrastructure for modern Web3 applications.
